name: Titanwake Delta
introDiscord:
Ancient wake channels branch across the delta like rivers.

Titanwake Drakes bask between them on Leviathan bones as though this
graveyard was built entirely for them.
introTwitch:
Ancient wake channels branch across the delta like rivers.

Titanwake Drakes bask between them on Leviathan bones as though this
graveyard was built entirely for them.

titanwake-delta-approach.prompt: Three ancient current channels split across the delta.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath a huge scale.

right.message: A Titanwake Drake slides from a Leviathan rib into the current.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Drake sleeping on bridge.

Bridge is rib.

Alternate route required.

Glimmer voted climb Drake.

Vote rejected.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative and support the veto.

titanwake-delta-depths.prompt: The delta branches around giant bones.

left.message:
A Drake rises from what looked like an ordinary pile of ancient
sediment.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests along the bank.

forward.message:
One Berry lies beside Shizuki's crossing plan:

'Plan A: around Drake.
Plan B: wait for Drake.
Plan C: Glimmer's illegal suggestion.'

titanwake-delta-threshold.prompt: Flooded Fangbank forms around an enormous jaw half-buried in sediment.

left.message:
A mineral spring bubbles behind the jaw.

Shizuki wrote:

'Drake-free rest spot.

Checked twice.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the verified rest spot untouched.

right.message:
A Titanwake Drake rises from behind the giant fang.

Verification expired.

forward.message: A wrecked strongbox lies under the jaw.

bossPromptDiscord:
The smaller Drakes abandon Fangbank.

An enormous scaled shape wakes beneath the ancient jaw.

Use /yes to enter Flooded Fangbank or /no to wait for the local wildlife
to finish using the Leviathan as furniture.
bossPromptTwitch:
The smaller Drakes abandon Fangbank.

An enormous scaled shape wakes beneath the ancient jaw.

Use !yes to enter Flooded Fangbank or !no to wait for the local wildlife
to finish using the Leviathan as furniture.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw.

A smaller Drake immediately reclaims the rib bridge.

boss.revealText:
An ancient Drake rises beneath the flooded bones.

Wakejaw Ancient reveals itself!

completionText:
The Wakejaw returns to the delta.

Glimmer's climbing proposal remains permanently rejected.
